purpose: Inventory of every committed text and Markdown file outside docs/archiv/ and docs/korpus/ — the repository is public, every one of them is product communication. Per file: purpose, audience, what it says today, what becomes wrong with 3.0 (with lines), the decision and the effort. The changeover itself comes with 3.0, not before (ROADMAP 3.0.8): until then the texts describe what is shipped. Held by tests/public-texts-guard.spec.ts.

schema.scope: git ls-files, extension .md/.mdx/.txt or LICENSE/NOTICE in the root directory, without docs/archiv/** and docs/korpus/**. Check (c) requires an entry in files[] for every such file and a file for every entry.
schema.files[].kind: root-doc | docs | runbook | policy | concept | plan | review | register | roadmap | log | skill | agent-brief | email | marketing | legal | abap-sample | draft
schema.files[].audience: who reads it (public, users, developers, agents, internal)
schema.files[].saysToday: what it says about the product today
schema.files[].wrongWith30[]: {lines, what}: what becomes wrong with 3.0. Manual entries plus the hits of the guard checks (a) and (b) on the reference date, with line numbers
schema.files[].decision: update (bring up to 3.0 in place) | archive (move to archiveTarget, entry in docs/archiv/README.md) | delete (history stays in Git) | keep (checked, nothing wrong with 3.0 — legal texts, source code, logs)
schema.files[].archiveTarget: only for archive: target folder under docs/archiv/
schema.files[].effort: none | XS (< 1 h) | S (half a day) | M (1-2 days) | L (several days)
schema.files[].guard: {removed, terms}: check | exempt per check (a) and (b); why when exempt
schema.files[].referencedBy: code, specs, scripts or workflows that name the path — update them when moving (CLAUDE.md: grep before every move)
schema.files[].measured.lines: line count on the reference date
schema.served[]: publicly served texts that are not a text file of their own (llms.txt, package.json, metadata, JSON-LD) and the design artefacts under docs/roadmap/*.html — only listed, not enforced by (c)
schema.referenceCheck[]: files in docs/archiv/ and docs/korpus/ that name a file that is archived or deleted — only check references there, do not rewrite
schema.baseline: number of violations of (a) and (b) on the reference date, once over all checked files and once only over those that stay (update/keep)
schema.decisions[]: decisions on the inventory with date: {id, date, by, decision, status (vollzogen | vermerkt | spaeter), files}
schema.files[].executed: date on which a decision was carried out: delete or archive moved or deleted, update rewritten. From then on a rewritten file is measured against (a) and (b) by tests/public-texts-guard.spec.ts immediately, not only once the switch is set.
schema.served[].executed: date on which the served text was brought up to 3.0

baseline.note: Today (a) and (b) are not armed (tests/public-texts-guard.spec.ts, PUBLIC_TEXTS_ARMED). The numbers are the baseline; with 3.0 both must reach 0.
baseline.updated: 2026-09-24 (decision Sonny 24.09.2026): byDecision recounted; files = entries including deletions carried out, filesPresent = files that still exist. effortDaysRough = 24.8 minus what has been carried out (SCREENING-GCP S, two mails at S each, six ABAP copies and two video files at XS each; XS = 0.1, S = 0.5 days) plus CONCEPT-DE-LOCALIZATION from XS to S. removed/terms stay the baseline of the reference date; the test "Ausgangswert" measures the current state.
